title: Verificar Live móvil: ahora, terminados, historial e inbox
mission: Independently verify the published Prometeo Live v3 human-facing mobile surface on a narrow viewport. Check that no page-wide horizontal overflow exists; the main view shows only open workers plus recent finished workers; stale/suspect/replaceable countdowns follow 6/10 minute policy; prior days are compressed into tappable bars; swipe navigation reaches Inbox/Projects/Production; Inbox messages show short ID + human text; and the page consumes the static feed without GitHub API exploration.
definition_of_done: Narrow/mobile viewport is checked for page-wide overflow and readable type.
Open workers, finished-today rows and day-history expansion are verified from feed evidence.
6m suspect / 10m replaceable presentation is checked against timestamps.
Inbox swipe view and message IDs are verified.
Any defect is fixed with CAS or returned as an exact bounded defect; no self-promotion to Human Accepted.
